title: Best Supply Chain Consultants (2026): Sourcing and Logistics
description: How to hire a supply chain expert for sourcing, suppliers, inventory planning or logistics: deliverables, data, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Supply chain experts help products move from suppliers to customers efficiently: finding and evaluating suppliers, planning inventory, improving logistics and reducing stock problems. They are useful for growing e-commerce brands, manufacturers and wholesalers. Projects go wrong when advice is generic, real costs and lead times are ignored, or supplier claims are not verified. This guide helps you get supply chain support grounded in your numbers.

faq.q: What can a supply chain expert help with?
faq.a: Supplier sourcing, quotes comparison, inventory planning, shipping options, warehouse choices and process improvements.
Many can. Ask how suppliers are vetted and whether samples and factory checks are included.

faq.q: Do they need my sales data?
faq.a: Yes, for inventory planning. Share sales history, lead times and stock levels.
Some do. Agree on who signs contracts and makes payments.
Customs, duties and product rules vary by country. Confirm details with a licensed broker or official sources.
